A ball is released from point X on a rough semicircular track. It comes to rest for an instant at
point Y. The gravitational potential energy of the ball at point X is EX. The gravitational potential
energy of the ball at point Y is EY.
X
Y
Which equation relates the energy of the ball at point X to its energy at point Y?
A
EX = EY + work done against friction
B
EX = EY – work done against friction
C
EX + EY = work done against friction
D
EX + EY + work done against friction = 0

options.label: A
options.text: EX = EY + work done against friction

options.label: B
options.text: EX = EY – work done against friction

options.label: C
options.text: EX + EY = work done against friction

options.label: D
options.text: EX + EY + work done against friction = 0
